Mapping marking addresses as banned bots.

Payable wallet receiving collected ETH fees.
Percentage of pair balance used as swap threshold, set by dev.

LP pair address created at trading open.
Reentrancy guard flag set during swap.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token to ETH swaps.
Flag enabling buy limit and cooldown checks.
Flag indicating whether the current transfer is a buy.
Maximum transaction amount enforced on buys.
Maximum wallet holding enforced on buys.
Owner address used by onlyOwner access checks.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Internal transfer entry point handling limits, bot checks and fee swaps.
Swaps contract tokens for ETH through the router under lockTheSwap.
Sends collected ETH to the fee wallet.

Dev-only fee setter bounded by initial total fees.
Applies reflection transfers, team take and fee reflection.

Dev-only manual trigger of ETH send to fee wallet.

Returns rSupply divided by tSupply.
Returns current reflection and token supplies.

Parameter of swapTokensForEth: amount of tokens to swap.
Parameter of _transfer: amount of tokens being transferred.
Parameter of _transfer: sender address.
Parameter of _transfer: recipient address.
Local in _transfer holding the capped contract token balance to swap.
Parameter of changeMaxTxAmount/changeMaxWalletSize percentage input.
Parameter of setFeeRate controlling the swap threshold.

Local in _takeTeam/_getRate holding the reflection rate.
Parameter of _transferStandard: token amount being moved.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by the _msgSender helper, propagating caller control.
Untrusted caller becomes the from address of internal transfers.
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender, so the caller controls privileged paths.
adjustFees is gated by owner/dev privileges tied to _owner.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline during openTrading.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external Uniswap swap entry point.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out of the contract.
sendETHToFee executes an ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
openTrading assigns the router instance into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the LP pair address.
openTrading performs the addLiquidityETH external payable call.
openTrading approves the router on the pair token with max allowance.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
_transfer delegates the accounting to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains r/t amounts from _getValues.
_getValues reads the current reflection rate.
_getRate derives its ratio from _getCurrentSupply.
_transfer writes the _isBuy tax branch flag.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer enforces the _maxWalletSize limit.
Automatic swap in _transfer is gated by swapEnabled.
_transfer checks inSwap to avoid recursive swapping.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap around the router call.
adjustFees mutates the _taxes struct fields.
setFeeRate writes the _feeRate threshold.
removeLimits resets _maxTxAmount to total supply.
removeLimits resets _maxWalletSize to total supply.
changeMaxTxAmount recomputes _maxTxAmount from a percentage.
changeMaxWalletSize recomputes _maxWalletSize from a percentage.
addBot sets bot flags in the bots mapping.
delBot clears the bot flag in the bots mapping.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router for the swap path.
_transferStandard performs sub/add arithmetic on _rOwned balances.
Fee reflection subtracts from _rTotal total reflection supply.
External router swap can call back into the token transfer flow before state settles.
_getValues reads buy/sell fees from the _taxes struct.
tokenAmount parameter flows into the swap external call.
amount parameter drives the transfer accounting.
from parameter drives pair and bot checks in _transfer.
to parameter drives wallet size and pair checks in _transfer.
contractTokenBalance local is passed into swapTokensForEth.
percentage parameter is used to size the new max tx amount.
rate parameter is stored into the fee rate state variable.
_bots array parameter is iterated to set bot flags.
notbot parameter clears the bot flag for an address.
currentRate local is computed inside the rate lookup.
tAmount parameter is decomposed into r/t values.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenAmount is only a parameter of swapTokensForEth and has no independent meaning.
amount only parameterizes the _transfer accounting logic.
from only parameterizes the _transfer sender checks.
to only parameterizes the _transfer recipient checks.
contractTokenBalance is a local computed in _transfer solely to call swapTokensForEth.
percentage is only a parameter of the max tx/limit setters.
rate is only a parameter of setFeeRate.
_bots is only a parameter array consumed by addBot.
notbot is only a parameter consumed by delBot.
currentRate is a local derived from _getRate's supply ratio.
tAmount is only a parameter of the transfer accounting routine.
